intro: This severed head is proof of the death of Baron Longshore, captain of the Southsea Freebooter vessel Heedless. Gazlowe posted a public bounty for the pirate's identifiable remains to protect Ratchet's commercial shipping along the Merchant Coast.

p: Operating out of camps along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet, Baron Longshore directed raids against regional merchant vessels on behalf of the Southsea Freebooters. His flagship, the Heedless, posed a direct threat to the goblin trade lanes linking Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms. Gazlowe, Chief Engineer of Ratchet, placed a bounty on Longshore requiring identifiable proof of demise. Delivering the pirate's head satisfies the contract and secures a monetary reward from the port authority.
